name: slite
label: Slite
description: Slite is a modern knowledge base. Create, search, update, and ask questions about your team docs.

token.label: API Key
token.description:
**Authenticate with your Slite API key.**

1. Open your organization menu at the top-left of the Slite app.
2. Go to **Settings → API**.
3. Click **Create a new key** and follow the steps.
4. Copy the key (it is shown only once) and paste it here.

ask_question.label: Ask Question
ask_question.description: Asks a question in natural language and returns an answer drawn from your Slite docs, with sources.

question.label: Question
question.description: The question to ask your Slite knowledge base.

parent_note_id.label: Parent Doc
parent_note_id.description: Limit the answer to docs nested under this parent.

create_doc.label: Create Doc
create_doc.description: Creates a doc inside a parent doc or your private channel.

title.label: Title
title.description: The title of the new doc.

parent_note_id.label: Parent Doc
parent_note_id.description: Where to create the new doc. Leave blank to create it in your private channel.

content_format.label: Content Format
content_format.description: How the content above is written.

template_id.label: Template ID
template_id.description: Apply a template to the new doc by its ID.

attributes.label: Attributes
attributes.description: Attributes for the parent collection, ordered by column. Ignored if they don't match the column type.

replace_doc.label: Replace Doc
replace_doc.description: Replaces the entire content and/or title of a doc. Fields you leave blank are kept unchanged.

note_id.label: Doc
note_id.description: Start typing to search your docs by title.

title.label: Title
title.description: A new title for the doc.

content.label: Content
content.description: New content that replaces the entire doc body.

content_format.label: Content Format
content_format.description: How the content above is written.

attributes.label: Attributes
attributes.description: Attributes for the parent collection, ordered by column.

index_askx_object.label: Index AskX Object
index_askx_object.description: Sends an object to be indexed by AskX for your custom source. Note: Slite has deprecated this endpoint.

root_id.label: Root ID
root_id.description: The root ID of your custom data source (created in Slite).

object_id.label: Object ID
object_id.description: A unique identifier for this object within the source.

type.label: Content Format
type.description: How the content above is written.

updated_at.label: Updated At
updated_at.description: When the object was last modified.

url.label: URL
url.description: The redirect URL for the object.

fetch_doc.label: Fetch Doc
fetch_doc.description: Returns a readable doc by its ID.

note_id.label: Doc
note_id.description: Start typing to search your docs by title.

format.label: Content Format
format.description: The format to return the doc content in.

search_docs.label: Search Docs
search_docs.description: Performs a keyword search across the docs you have access to.

parent_note_id.label: Parent Doc
parent_note_id.description: Limit results to docs nested under this parent.

hits_per_page.label: Results Per Page
hits_per_page.description: How many results to return per page (1–100).

page.label: Page
page.description: Which page of results to return (starts at 0).

update_doc.label: Update Doc
update_doc.description: Updates a specific part (tile) of a doc. Fields you leave blank are kept unchanged.

note_id.label: Doc
note_id.description: Start typing to search your docs by title.

tile_id.label: Tile ID
tile_id.description: The block to update. In Slite, hover an empty line, open its menu, and choose "Copy block id".

title.label: Title
title.description: New header text for the tile.

content.label: Content
content.description: New Markdown content for the tile.

url.label: URL
url.description: An external link for the tile.

icon_url.label: Icon URL
icon_url.description: An icon to display on the tile.

status_label.label: Status Label
status_label.description: Text for the tile status badge.

status_color.label: Status Color
status_color.description: Status badge color as a hex code, e.g. #2F80ED.
